title: Sulfur Cube Props
description: Rename Sulfur Cubes to discover new Props to use in your World!
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d0b8bcec8ceab46b7c654c9e33708db0a1213ef5.png) ###
26.2+
This pack adds a regularly updated set of new textures for Sulfur Cubes when they are renamed with a Name Tag. A full list of all of the Props in the pack with their respective Name Tags can be seen in the Changelog. Make sure to check back here for new additions to the pack!


![Dependencies](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e6fb65dd664eec9540bf2a162afc8d52c9bb93bb.png) ###
Requires ETF and EMF
